definitions: A computational problem of constructing or updating a map of an unknown environment while simultaneously keeping track of an agent's location within it.
The set of techniques and algorithms used to enable a robot or autonomous vehicle to build a map of its surroundings and localise itself within that map at the same time.
examples: SLAM technology is crucial for autonomous navigation.
Advancements in SLAM technology have improved robotic mapping.
Researchers are developing new SLAM technology algorithms.
